walkthroughs.body_html: The French baguette has a thin crisp crust and soft inside. Sourdough uses a wild yeast starter for tangy flavour. Ciabatta is Italian — big airy holes.
Pitta (Middle East) puffs into a pocket. Naan (India) is baked in a hot clay oven called a tandoor. Tortillas (Mexico) are made from corn or wheat.
Most use flour, water, yeast and salt — the differences come from technique, temperature, time and shape. Bread is the world's most universal food.
